Subject: BrightLane invoice channel: portal-first policy, email fallback & compact CSV template

Hi Emma / Team,

Thanks for completing the vendor enrollment form — welcome! A couple quick details to make the invoice submission handoff smooth:

1) Portal-first: our supplier portal is the preferred path for all invoices. It provides immediate PO matching, automatic ack, and is the fastest way to avoid payment delays.

2) Email fallback: we accept invoices by email as a secondary route for providers who cannot onboard to the portal immediately. If you need to use email, please use "invoices@redwood.ai" and include the PO number in the subject (e.g. "PO 123456 - Invoice 2026-11-01"). Email invoices require manual processing and could add 2-4 business days.

3) Compact CSV template: attached is a minimal CSV we prefer for portal bulk uploads or as a machine-readable email attachment. The template includes: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, tax_amount, supplier_remittance_id.

Attached: supplier_compact_template.csv (sample) + a short PO-stamping guidance PDF.

Can you confirm whether BrightLane will onboard to the portal this quarter or need the email fallback for now? If email fallback, can you confirm whether you will send a single attachment per invoice (PDF) or a CSV for batch invoices?

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts (North America)
Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi (and Vanessa),

Thanks for the note and the attachments — this helps. Quick answers from our side:

- Portal adoption: we can complete portal onboarding but need SSO details and an account admin invite. ETA: end of next week.
- Interim: we'll use email fallback for immediate invoices. We operate from an ERP that can export one CSV per payment run; we'd prefer to send a single batched CSV each week rather than many PDFs.

A couple of template questions: 1) For line_description, do you allow comma characters (our ERP escapes them with double quotes)? 2) For tax_amount, do you want tax per-line or a single tax_total field at invoice level? 3) PO stamping: will you accept invoices where the PO is on a separate remittance file, or must PO be present on each invoice row?

If helpful I can share a sample CSV we export (anonymized) so we can align fields.

Best,
Emma Jenkins
Senior Vendor Manager
BrightLane Corp

Hi Emma — thanks for the quick reply and the sample export. A few clarifications to keep processing simple and deterministic:

- Commas in line_description: yes, we accept comma characters; typical CSV quoting is fine (double quotes). Our ingestion pipeline parses RFC4180-style CSVs.

- Tax fields: prefer tax per-line where available (tax_amount on each line). If your ERP only provides an invoice-level tax_total, include tax_total as an additional column and set per-line tax_amount to 0.00 — we'll allocate tax during ingest.

- PO presence: PO number must be associated with each invoice row in the CSV (po_number column). We do not accept a separate remittance file as the single source of truth for PO matching — po_number on the invoice rows is required to avoid manual reconciliation.

Notes on the batched CSV flow:
- File name convention: BRIGHTLANE_YYYYMMDD_batch.csv
- One CSV per payment run, max 5,000 rows.
- If any row fails PO match, we will surface an exception report and retry window (48 hours).

Kimberly, looping you for any compliance / PO-stamp exceptions that should be handled differently for enterprise partners.

Next steps for SSO/portal: Vanessa will send the admin invite and SSO onboarding doc today. Once you accept, we can test with a 5-row sample and switch off the email fallback.

Cheers —
Rishi

Hi Emma — welcome aboard and thank you for the quick turnaround. I sent the portal admin invite this afternoon (link in separate email) and included the SSO checklist in the Drive link we shared. A couple of operational points so your finance team can prepare:

- Please use the file naming convention RLA_BRIGHTLANE_YYYYMMDD_batch.csv to help our automated ingestion tag the file to your account.
- If you plan weekly batches, pick a fixed day/time for the weekly run so our ops can align processing windows (we typically process nightly PST).
- Exception SLA: 48 hours to respond to a PO match exception before our ops team starts manual reconciliation (we'll hold payment until resolved).

I'll follow up with a 5-row onboarding test window once SSO is accepted. If you have any restrictions that prevent PO per-row, flag them and we'll evaluate a short-term manual mapping exception for that specific case.

Welcome again — looking forward to a smooth go-live.

Vanessa Ortiz
